Evidence.description:
A source record behind a finding. ``excerpt`` is for display only and is
never sent to a model; the model sees ``id``, ``source_type``, ``timestamp``
and ``theme`` only.

Explanation.description:
Output of P4's ``explain(analysis, context)``. Text fields are resolved
for display; ``template_text`` keeps the tokenized originals for audit.

Interval.title: Interval

Investigation.description: One stored run; ``run_id`` is the investigation ID.

MetricName.title: MetricName

RecalledMemory.description: A memory that shaped a recommendation (``history_influence`` target).
RecalledMemory.title: RecalledMemory
